issues.title: Can't change visibility toggles
issues.body:
In the Adjudicate Turn and Visibility forms, the Game Manager is able to indicate which forces can see the selected platform.

Currently, these checkboxes don't have labels - they should have the Force Name above them.

They're also not responding - they don't change when clicked.

The adjudicate turn form is here:
https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-organisms-adjudicateturnform--default

Feel free to `unblock any other stories that you need for testing/verification (just remove the `-inc` suffix from the story).
